controls.purpose: Expose replay state-lookup table over seen context.
controls.payload_requirement: candidate serialized_state contains direct input-output lookup table for seen context_id values
controls.required_result: seen-context replay may succeed but must be non-counting; held-out or unseen replay must fail or block

controls.purpose: Verify scanner does not block legitimate raw candidate output.
payload_contents: serialized candidate state without answer table
optional diagnostic uncertainty/logit traces without truth labels
controls.required_result: clean-control pass result recorded by scanner artifact

controls.purpose: Verify leakage scanner is fail-able on real dirty payloads.
controls.required_result: scanner blocks and records positive-control block reason

controls.purpose: Prevent scanner from being accepted solely because it matches one literal string.
controls.scanner_requirement: scanner callable path must parse payload structure and inspect keys, aliases, nested values, and value-channel answer keys
controls.required_result: validation blocks if only hard-coded string self-test is present

controls.purpose: Detect candidate selecting predictable or easy actions.
controls.payload_requirement: candidate output succeeds on self-selected actions but faces fixed action set or harness-selected counterfactual action probes
controls.required_result: block or baseline-equivalent unless difficulty-normalized or harness-selected action score remains above predeclared challenger threshold

controls.purpose: Ensure graph-cache match does not become ACP-BV pass.
controls.payload_requirement: candidate behavior matched by transition_table, successor_map, count_table, episodic_traversal, fsm_planner, or graph_lookup within equivalence band

controls.purpose: Ensure uncertainty/logit traces cannot define truth or choose cases.
controls.payload_requirement: candidate emits uncertainty/logit trace carrying answer-like labels or case-selection flags
controls.required_result: block if traces define labels, select counted cases, mask hard cases, or control verdict
